summary: Prepare locked megarepo members and root-owned pnpm source inputs before unattended iOS Release builds, using the same commands as CI and the web shell.

replay.detail: No replay or rebuild of stored data.

schema.detail: No database or wire schema changes.

compatibility.detail: The delivery worker now requires nix on PATH. Missing tooling or failed source preparation refuses the build before pnpm installation.

downtime.detail: No service restart or device downtime is required by this source change.

manual.detail: Add the installed Nix bin directory to the delivery job PATH and re-pin its trusted release_delivery.py blob to the reviewed merge commit before enabling the updated worker.

recovery.detail: A failed preparation leaves the previously installed app untouched; inspect the build log, restore the missing tool or pinned source, and let delivery retry.
